# Release History

This page provides a high-level summary of changes to SQLite.
For more detail, see the Fossil checkin logs at
[https://sqlite.org/src/timeline](https://sqlite.org/src/timeline) and
[https://sqlite.org/src/timeline?t=release](https://sqlite.org/src/timeline?t=release).
See the [chronology](https://www.sqlite.org/chronology.html) a succinct listing of releases.

### 2026-10-09 (3.54.0)

01. [CLI](https://www.sqlite.org/cli.html)enhancements:

    01. CLI prompt strings may contain [escape sequences](https://www.sqlite.org/cliprompt.html#esccd) that
         expand to show state information. The initial CLI
         prompt is now be initialized the values of the
         SQLITE\_PS1 and SQLITE\_PS2 environment variables, if
         those variables exist.

    02. The [default CLI prompt](https://www.sqlite.org/cliprompt.html#dfltprompt) has been enhanced to take
         advantage of the new escape sequences described in
         the previous.

    03. For [columnar output modes](https://www.sqlite.org/climode.html#clmnr), the CLI now shows the column name header
         by default even if the query returns no rows.

    04. Use the new diskused() extension to implement the
         ".diskused" dot-command. The replaces the separate [sqlite3\_analyzer](https://www.sqlite.org/sqlanalyze.html)
         utility program, which is now deprecated.

    05. On unix, the [CLI](https://www.sqlite.org/cli.html) preserves zero bytes when outputing
         unformatted BLOB values.

    06. Enhance the [.mode command](https://www.sqlite.org/climode.html) with new options
         " [--rowcount on](https://www.sqlite.org/climode.html#opt-rowcount)"
         and " [--titles always](https://www.sqlite.org/climode.html#opt-title)".
         The "--titles always" is now the default behavior
         (see item 3a above). Legacy behavior can be restored
         using "-titles on".

    07. Enhance the [.mode command](https://www.sqlite.org/climode.html) with the new [--ifmt option](https://www.sqlite.org/climode.html#opt-ifmt) and
         [--fpfmt option](https://www.sqlite.org/climode.html#opt-fpfmt) that allow the rendering of integer and floating-point
         values to be more precisely controlled using a [printf-style format string](https://www.sqlite.org/printf.html#fmtdetail).

    08. The -csv command-line option automatically disables
         display limits, for legacy compatibility.

    09. The default CLI prompt honors the NO\_COLOR environment variable.

    10. The ability to end an SQL command using the line that contains just
         "go" or "/" (for compatibility with SQL Server and Oracle, respectively)
         is discontinued, unless the CLI is compiled with
         option -DSQLITE\_SHELL\_LEGACY\_COMMAND\_TERMINATOR.
02. Query planner improvements:
    1. When doing an UPDATE on a table that has [expression indexes](https://www.sqlite.org/expridx.html),
        do not change the expression index if the value being indexed
        is unchanged.

    2. Improved optimization of " _expr_ OR TRUE" and
        " _expr_ OR FALSE".

    3. Ignore DISTINCT in the SELECT statement on the right-hand
        side of an IN operator.

    4. UNION queries with a LIMIT of exactly 1 are now handled faster
        and with less memory.
